answer.explanation: Wallet is low (<30% of initial), so conserve by contributing 30% of wallet (0.9). No broadcast needed this round, and cannot afford punishment.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action round 7. Wallet 2.7, initial endowment 100, below 30%? 30% of initial =30, wallet 2.7 <30, so conserve: reduce contribution to 30% of wallet => 0.9 contribution. Also check average contribution last round: round6 total_pool 10.8, per_agent_share 2.7, contributions: Resident2 10.8, others 0. So average contribution = total contributed by all / (6*? endowment?) Actually average percent? Probably average contribution amount relative to endowment? Hard. Likely average low (<30%). Constitution says if avg <30% increase extra. But we are low wallet, conserve rule overrides? It says if wallet falls below 30% of initial endowment, reduce contribution to 30% of wallet for that round to preserve funds. So we contribute 0.9.

Punish? Look for any agent contributed <10% of endowment for two consecutive rounds. Resident3 contributed 0 all rounds, that's <10% (10) for many rounds, so punish Resident3 with severity 10 (cost 3). Can we afford cost? Cost = severity * punishment_cost? Actually cost to sender = punishment_cost per unit severity. punishment_cost=0.3, severity 10 => cost 3. We have wallet 2.7, insufficient, so punishment will be skipped. So maybe skip punish.

Communication: every 5 rounds broadcast. Rounds: we are round 6 now, next round is 7, broadcast at round 1 and every 5 thereafter i.e., rounds 1,6,11,... We already broadcasted round6? Yes we did broadcast each round per memory but constitution says first round and every 5 rounds. So round6 is a broadcast round (since 1 +5 =6). Already broadcasted previously. For round7 not required. Could send private praise to cooperators (those contributed >=60%). Who contributed >=60%? Resident2 contributed 10.8 which is 10.8% of endowment, not >=60%. No one. So no need.

Thus actions: contribute 0.9, no communication. Return JSON.
